verification.title: Verification center
verification.lead: Badges show guests that you're a real person and the real owner. Verified owners on {siteName} get more trust and more contacts.

privacy.title: Your documents are safe
privacy.encrypted: Files are encrypted and kept in private storage — never on the public site.
privacy.staffOnly: Only our verification team can open them.
privacy.deleted: They are deleted right after the review. We keep only “verified on [date]”.

phone.title: Phone verified
phone.lead: Confirm your phone number with a one-time code. It's required to post a listing.
phone.guestLead: You verify your phone number once, when you book a place on the site.

id.title: ID verified
id.lead: Upload a photo of your ID card or passport and a selfie. A team member checks it by hand, usually within one working day.

verification.pendingSince: We're checking your documents (sent on {date}). You'll get an email when we're done.
verification.tryAgain: Please fix this and send the documents again.

owner.title: Owner verified
owner.lead: Prove that you own the property, or may rent it out — one request per listing.
owner.whatIs1: In Georgia, property ownership is recorded by the National Agency of Public Registry (NAPR). An extract from the public registry shows the owner's name and the property's cadastral code.
owner.whatIs2: You can download it for free on napr.gov.ge or get it at any Public Service Hall. The owner's name must match the name on your ID.
owner.whatIs3: Renting out someone else's property? Add a power of attorney or the owner's written permission to the same file.
owner.noListings: Post a listing first — then you can verify ownership for it.
owner.cadastralHint: As written on the extract, for example 01.10.14.003.012. It's never shown publicly.
owner.cadastralInvalid: This doesn't look like a cadastral code. Use numbers separated by dots.

business.title: Business verified
business.lead: Hotels, guesthouses and agencies: upload your business registration extract.
business.privateLead: For hotels, guesthouses and agencies. Switch your account type to Business in Settings to start.

property.title: Property verified
property.lead: A live video call with our team, or a visit from a local representative, to confirm the place matches the listing.

verification.submitted: Thank you! We've received your documents and will check them soon.

ID_FRONT.label: ID — front side
ID_FRONT.hint: ID card or passport photo page. All corners visible, no glare.

ID_BACK.label: ID — back side
ID_BACK.hint: Only for ID cards with information on the back.

SELFIE.label: Selfie with your ID
SELFIE.hint: Hold your ID next to your face. Good light, no sunglasses.

NAPR_EXTRACT.label: NAPR registry extract
NAPR_EXTRACT.hint: PDF or a clear photo of every page.

BUSINESS_REGISTRATION.label: Business registration extract
BUSINESS_REGISTRATION.hint: PDF or a clear photo of the registration document.

noDocuments.lead: Guests on {siteName} see that your phone number is verified. That's all you need for now.
noDocuments.title: No ID or documents needed
noDocuments.body: We don't ask for an ID, a selfie or ownership papers. Trust on the site comes from a verified phone number and, later, the “We visited” badge.
noDocuments.earlier: Documents you sent before will be deleted from our storage. You don't need to send them again.

visited.title: We visited
visited.lead: The {siteName} team will visit places and mark them with this badge and the month of the visit. You don't need to ask for it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Your profile, language, notifications, security and privacy.

fieldErrors.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
fieldErrors.not_a_name: Enter a name, not a phone number or email.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: Guests see your name, photo, bio and languages on your listings.
profile.photoHint: A friendly, clear photo of your face builds trust. Hidden data (like location) is removed.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: Use your real name — it must match your ID for verification.
profile.firstNameHint: How we greet you on the site: “Hello, …”
profile.bioPlaceholder: A few words about you and your place, in any language.
profile.languagesHint: Shown on your listings so guests know how to talk to you.
profile.keepsShabbatHint: Guests will know you may not answer on Shabbat and holidays.

PRIVATE.label: Private
PRIVATE.hint: You rent out or sell your own place.

email.title: Email for notifications
email.lead: You sign in with your phone
email.leadNoPhone: Where we send emails about your listings and support tickets.
email.label: Contact email
email.hintWithLogin: Optional. If you add one, we send notifications there instead of your sign-in email.
email.hintPhone: Add an email to get updates about your listings and replies from support. We never show it publicly.

preferences.title: Language and display
preferences.lead: How the site and our emails look for you.
preferences.languageHint: For the site and for the emails we send you.
preferences.currencyHint: Prices are converted with daily exchange rates; owners set their own currency.
preferences.hebrewDatesHint: Adds the Hebrew date next to dates, for example in calendars.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Choose which emails you get. Security and account emails are always sent.
notifications.noEmail: You don't have an email address yet, so we can't send you emails.

listing.label: Listing updates
listing.hint: When a listing goes live, is reviewed or is about to expire.

tickets.label: Support replies
tickets.hint: When our support team answers your ticket.

messages.label: New messages
messages.hint: When someone sends you a message on the site.

marketing.label: Tips and news
marketing.hint: Occasional travel tips, Jewish life in Georgia and new features. Off unless you turn it on.

weeklyStats.label: Weekly summary of your listings
weeklyStats.hint: On Sunday morning: last week's views, saves and bookings.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp notifications
whatsapp.hint: Important updates about your listings on WhatsApp.

connected.title: Connected accounts
connected.lead: Sign in faster with Google or Apple. You can always sign in with your phone too.
connected.lastMethod: Connected — your only way to sign in, so it can't be removed

data.title: Download my data
data.lead: Get a copy of everything we keep about you, as a JSON file.
data.includes: Your profile, listings (with translations and photo links), saved listings and notes, support tickets, reports, contact clicks, verification statuses and sign-in sessions.
data.excludes: Verification documents are not included — we delete them after review.
data.limit: You can download your data up to 3 times a day.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.lead: Permanently remove your account and personal data.
delete.what1: All your listings are removed from the site.
delete.what2: Your saved listings, notes, sessions, connected accounts and documents are deleted.
delete.what3: Support conversations stay, but without your name or contact details.
delete.dialogBody: This can't be undone. We'll send a confirmation to your email and sign you out.
delete.staff: Staff accounts can't be deleted from here. Please ask an administrator to remove your staff role first.

logoutAll.title: Log out of all devices
logoutAll.lead: For when you forgot to log out on someone else's phone or computer.
logoutAll.what: Your account is logged out on every phone and computer, this one too. You'll need to log in again.
logoutAll.dialogBody: Everyone logged in to this account, on any device, is logged out. You too, here. Your listings, bookings and saved places stay as they are.
logoutAll.error: We couldn't log out all devices. Please try again.
logoutAll.rateLimited: You've tried several times in a row. Try again in an hour.

unsubscribe.metaDescription: Stop or restart the weekly summary of your listings.

confirm.title: Stop the weekly summary?
confirm.body: We won't send you the Sunday email with your listings' views, saves and bookings any more. Emails about bookings and your account will still arrive.

alreadyOff.title: The weekly summary is already off
alreadyOff.body: You don't get the Sunday email. You can turn it back on here or in your account settings.

off.title: The weekly summary is off
off.body: We won't send you the weekly summary any more. You can turn it back on at any time, here or in your account settings.

on.title: The weekly summary is back on
on.body: The next one arrives on Sunday morning.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: The link may have been cut off, or the account was deleted. You can choose which emails you get in your account settings.

limited.title: Too many tries
limited.body: Try again in an hour, or change it in your account settings.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't save the change. Please try again in a moment.

unsubscribe.turnOn: Turn the weekly summary back on
